d:
Sonu Kumar, the 'viral boy' from Bihar, is back in the spotlight—this time, not because of his studies, but because of a statement he made. Sonu revealed that he does not get his hair cut by just anyone. This remark has sparked a debate on social media; some are accusing him of promoting casteism and untouchability, while others view it as a matter of personal preference linked to his religious beliefs.
